snippet.title: Tin Hearts VR | Launch Trailer | @WiredP
snippet.description:
Behind every brilliant invention, hides an incredible story. From members of the team that brought you Fable, comes Tin Hearts – a narrative puzzle adventure game wrapped in a powerful tale of love and compromise.  

We are pleased to announce the long-anticipated VR update for @rogue suns narrative puzzle adventure, Tin Hearts, has been released today on PC VR and PS VR2, marking the completion of the games development journey.

Originally envisioned as a VR experience in the ‘Tin Hearts: Prologue’ which was released for early access in 2018, the free VR update is a gift and thank you to the players who have supported the game's journey over the past 6 years.

Thanks to the hard work of the development team, Rogue Sun, the free update allows players to experience the beautiful world of Tin Hearts from a whole new perspective.

Play Tin Hearts here: https://bit.ly/TinHeartsVR

#PlayStation #PSVR2 #PCVR #tinhearts #indiegame
